The '''Spice rack''' is used as an upgrade for the [[Cauldron]]. It will typically be the first upgrade for the cauldron due to its low cost.

== Usage ==
=== Level 2 Cauldron items include: ===
* {{Item link|Black Soup}}
* {{Item link|Muckshake}} - introduced in [[Version history#0.202.14 .28HEARTH .26 HOME.29|Hearth and Home]].
* {{Item link|Onion Soup}}
* {{Item link|Sausages}}
* {{Item link|Serpent Stew}}
* {{Item link|Turnip Stew}}

* For other upgrades, see [[Cauldron]].

Must be placed hanging from the ceiling or a shelf. Can be done using a [[Wood Beam 2 m|wood beam]].

== Notes ==
* The Spice rack was introduced in [[Version history#0.202.14 .28HEARTH .26 HOME.29|Hearth and Home]] on September 16th, 2021.
